title: Jesus... Everyone At The Wedding Asked When It's My Turn
topic: relatives asking when it is her turn at a family wedding

bible.text: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... four aunties asked when it's my turn. I smiled at the wedding and cried in the car. 💍

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I was in that car. I heard every word you didn't say.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Did I miss some deadline everyone else got?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: There's no deadline with your name on it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why do I feel so behind?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Their calendar is not your calling. You owe no one an update.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your story isn't late. It's being written with care.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who dreads the next wedding. What question are you tired of answering? 👇
